description: `:erlang.abs(-3)` compiles as field access on the atom and fails at runtime: StructField: subject is not a map or Struct. A call on an atom-named module must be a remote call (compile error if the module is unknown). Add an `:erlang` module providing `float_to_binary/2` with `decimals: N` (used by tools/distill-telemetry.exs:378 fmt_ms). Elixir semantics: fixed-decimal rendering, round-half-even per Erlang's float_to_binary.
title: `:atom.fun(args)` is a remote call; :erlang.float_to_binary/2
